title: Counter tape update action
statement: For a head movement $d\in\{-1,0,+1\}$ and a scanned tape value $w\in\{\text{blank},\text{false},\text{true}\}$, define a one-step action for a one-work-tape Boolean machine with states $0,1,2,3$. If $w=\text{true}$, the action moves the input head by $d$, writes false on the work tape, moves its head right, emits no output, and enters state $1$; otherwise it moves the input head by $d$, writes true, moves the work-tape head left, emits no output, and enters state $2$.
hypotheses_covered: Input-head movement $d$ is a sign in $\{-1,0,+1\}$
Scanned work-tape value is blank, false, or true
